== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Uncharted Settlements (Errata)]] (<code>1240_91</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 91E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-91E-Uncharted_Settlements.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-unchartedsettlements-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Uncharted Settlements]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text (card list):''' “Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base. Organized Attack, S-foils, Revolution, Your Destiny (unless you chose Rebel/Rebel Starship), and [Virtual Block 4] Ellors Madak are canceled. You may not deploy operatives or [Maintenance] cards. Force generation at Endor system may not be canceled. Unless Leave Them To Me on table, opponent's combat vehicles, Dark Jedi, [Maintenance] cards, and [Permanent Weapon] cards are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. (Immune to Alter.)(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_91</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB4-91E-Uncharted_Settlements-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B32 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
